meta.title: PCB Missing Component Detector (Task B)
meta.subtitle: Offline Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) with ECC Alignment, Local ZNCC, Recipe Management & Operator Sign-off

components.label: Assembly Operator
components.explanation: Human operator capturing PCB images, adjusting sensitivity, reviewing flagged defects, and signing off on uncertain components.

components.label: Live Camera Station
components.explanation: Client-side video stream capture station with live crosshairs, fixed positioning guidance, and frame freezing for reference and test boards.

components.label: Recipe Engine
components.explanation: Exports and imports JSON inspection recipes with 256-bit luminance Average Hash (aHash) fingerprinting and aspect-ratio mismatch warnings.

components.label: Interactive ROI Canvas
components.explanation: Allows drawing and editing normalized bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] on golden reference boards with sensitivity controls.

components.label: Batch Inspection UI
components.explanation: Multi-board batch upload console with live status chips, side-by-side reference vs test crop diff viewer, and alignment metrics.

components.label: Operator Sign-Off & KPI
components.explanation: Interactive audit panel for verifying PRESENT or confirming MISSING on uncertain parts with badge ID and notes, dynamic yield calculations, and printable reports.

components.label: FastAPI Web Server
components.explanation: FastAPI application managing REST endpoints for reference upload, recipe validation, multi-board inspection, audit export, and static asset serving.

components.label: Session State Store
components.explanation: In-memory dictionary mapping session UUIDs to golden reference OpenCV matrices, component coordinates, inspection run history, and audit logs.

components.label: Global ECC Aligner
components.explanation: Computes Enhanced Correlation Coefficient maximization matrix to rigidly align incoming test boards to golden reference coordinates down to sub-pixel accuracy.

components.label: Local ZNCC Correlator
components.explanation: Performs local sub-pixel translation search and Zero-mean Normalized Cross-Correlation alongside normalized Mean Absolute Difference (Patch Diff).

components.label: 3-State Decision Logic
components.explanation: Applies calibrated dual-threshold gates (ZNCC >= 0.89 OK, ZNCC <= 0.86 DEFECT, intermediate REVIEW) to classify missing components safely.

components.label: Inspection Report Exporter
components.explanation: Generates downloadable inspection audit CSV files and formatted printable inspection reports retaining original machine verdicts alongside human operator overrides.

cards.title: Frontend Offline Client
items: Vanilla JS + CSS without CDN or external dependencies
HTML5 Canvas bounding box editor with normalized coordinates
Webcam/USB camera capture station with alignment guidance

cards.title: Human-in-the-Loop & Audit
items: Preserves raw machine verdicts alongside human operator overrides
Tracks badge ID, timestamps, and operator notes per component
Computes First-Pass Yield (FPY) vs post-sign-off Operational Yield
Exports full audit log as CSV and printable inspection report
